title: Capital Letters and Sentence Endings
introduction: Write sentences with correct capital letters and punctuation.
definition: Write sentences with correct capital letters and punctuation.
rules: Start sentences and proper names with capital letters.
Use full stops for statements and question marks for direct questions.

examples.question: Correct: i play on monday.
steps: Capitalise I and the name of the day.

examples.question: Add punctuation: Where is my scarf
steps: A direct question ends with a question mark.

exercises.question: Correct: i play on monday.
exercises.solution: Capitalise I and the name of the day.

exercises.question: Add punctuation: Where is my scarf
exercises.solution: A direct question ends with a question mark.

exercises.question: Correct: ali lives in malaysia.
exercises.solution: Capitalise the person's name and country name.

exercises.question: Add punctuation: We are at the beach
exercises.solution: A statement ends with a full stop.

exercises.question: Add punctuation to show excitement: Hooray
exercises.solution: An exclamation mark can show excitement.

exercises.question: Correct: she reads on friday.
exercises.solution: Capitalise the first word and the day name.

summary: Write sentences with correct capital letters and punctuation. Start sentences and proper names with capital letters.
